questions.text: S and M can do a piece of work in 9 days, while M alone can finish it in 12 days. In how many days can S alone finish the work?
What is the average marks of all the students if the average marks of three batches of 55, 60, and 45 students is 50, 55, and 60, respectively?
A starts a business with ₹45,000 and was joined afterwards by B with ₹30,000. When did B join if the profit at the end of the year was divided in the ratio 2 : 1?

Ram reads 200 pages at the rate of 70 pages/hour in the morning. In the evening, when he was tired, he read 200 pages at the rate of 30 pages/hour. What was his average rate of reading, in pages per hour?
The six-digit number 7x1yyx is a multiple of 33 for non-zero digits x and y. Which of the following could be a possible value of (x + y)?
A book seller bought a book for Rs.40 and sold it for Rs.45. Find his gain percentage.
Despite giving 23% discount on the book, Raj makes 10% profit. If Raj earns Rs.63 profit, then find the marked price of the book.

A family member spends 25% of his monthly income on food, 35% of the remaining on a home loan and other bank debts, and half of the rest on the education of the children. If the member saves $46,215 every year, then the monthly income of the member is:
In a grocery shop, Samarth sold 950 g of sugar to a customer in place of 1 kg for ₹54. The cost price of 1 kg sugar was ₹36. How much profit (in ₹) did he earn on selling the sugar?
Find the simple interest on ₹24,000 at 18% per annum for a period of 7 months.
In an 800 m race, the ratio of the speeds of two contestants Alka and Mira is 4 : 7. If Alka has a start of 520 m, then, Alka will win by:
A certain amount of work can be done by a man, a woman and a boy in 20, 30 and 60 days, respectively. How many boys should be there in order to complete the work in 2 days with 2 men and 8 women?
What annual payment will discharge a debt of ₹1,936 in four annual equal instalments at the rate of 14% on simple interest?
Which of the following numbers is divisible by 12?
A person covers 35 km distance at the speed of 45 km/h, and after that he covers 95 km distance at the speed of 105 km/h. What is the average speed during the whole journey?

To pack a set of books, Surbhi made a carton that was 48 inches long, 27 inches wide and 30 inches tall. What will be the total surface area (in square feet) of this carton, once it closed from all sides? [Use 1 foot = 12 inches]
Simple interest gained on ₹9,000 at the rate of 8% is equal to ₹2,160. Calculate the time.

The ratio of the number of boys to that of girls in a village is 5 : 3. If 40% of the boys and 60% of the girls appeared in an examination, then the ratio of the number of boys and girls who appeared in the examination to the number who did not appear in the same examination, is:
After offering two successive discounts of 10% each, the seller earns 10% profit. The cost price is what per cent (rounded off to 2 decimal places) of the tag price?
The cost price of 15 apples is the same as the selling price of 12 apples. Find the percentage profit.
Rekha has two laptops of the same kind. She sold one of them at ₹32,000 and incurred a loss of 20%. At what price (in ₹) should she sell the second laptop to gain a profit of 20%?
A runs 4/3 times as fast as B. In a race, if A gives a lead of 80 m to B, find the distance from the starting point where they both will meet.
